titleEn: Check if Numbers Are Ascending in a Sentence
title: 检查句子中的数字是否递增
summary: 句子中数字由空格分隔且无前导零，判断它们按出现顺序是否严格递增。
insight: 按空格拆词，只处理首字符为数字的词；解析整数并与上一个数字比较，必须严格更大。

solutions.title: 词元数字扫描
solutions.idea: 依次解析数字词并维护上一个值。
steps: 若 token 首字符是数字，解析 current；current<=previous 返回 false，否则更新，最终 true

code.java: class Solution { public boolean areNumbersAscending(String s){int previous=-1;for(String token:s.split(" "))if(Character.isDigit(token.charAt(0))){int current=Integer.parseInt(token);if(current<=previous)return false;previous=current;}return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun areNumbersAscending(s:String):Boolean{var previous=-1;for(token in s.split(' '))if(token[0].isDigit()){val current=token.toInt();if(current<=previous)return false;previous=current};return true} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool areNumbersAscending(string s){stringstream stream(s);string token;int previous=-1;while(stream>>token)if(isdigit(token[0])){int current=stoi(token);if(current<=previous)return false;previous=current;}return true;} };
